exposure: Ultrasound-guided high-intensity focused ultrasound (USgHIFU) for uterine fibroids
outcome: Fibroid-associated symptoms (hypermenorrhea, pelvic pressure, frequent urination)
cohort: 35 patients with 44 symptomatic uterine fibroids were treated by USgHIFU.
finding: USgHIFU resulted in significant shrinkage of uterine fibroids and improvement of leading fibroid-associated symptoms, independent of Funaki type.
